ValidationRule.description: If Approved Temporarily = true and Fraud Result = Decline then Fraud Decline Reason is Mandatory
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( ($User.LastName <> "Integration"), ISPICKVAL(Type, "Credit Limit Increase Application"), ISPICKVAL(cc_Request_Type__c, "permanent"), cc_Approved_Temporarily__c == true, ISCHANGED(Fraud_Results__c), ISPICKVAL(Fraud_Results__c, "Decline"), ISBLANK(cc_Credit_Fraud_Team_Decline_Reason__c) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Please fill in the Credit Fraud Decline Reason Field.
